are these popular characters academic role models or not
personal assessment

rory gilmore
✅ reads constantly, organized, actually loves learning
❌ her whole worth depends on school. one bad review and she falls apart.
verdict: role model, with breaks

elle woods
✅ decided to get into law school and just did the work
✅ stayed herself the whole time
verdict: role model. underestimated = motivated.

paris geller
✅ the most prepared person in any room
❌ stresses about everything, burns out often
verdict: copy her preparation, not her panic

matilda
✅ reads for fun, curious about everything
✅ learned because she wanted to, not for grades
verdict: the purest role model on this list

my takeaway: be curious like matilda, prepared like paris,
and test yourself on your notes like you mean it.

and like all of them: phone away when it's time to work.
none of them were scrolling during exam week.
